newsList.News_Title: PBLPBOND: Trustee Meeting to declare Coupon Rate
newsList.News_Text: Pubali Bank PLC has informed that a meeting of the Trustee of Pubali Bank Perpetual Bond will be held on March 16, 2025 at 3:00 PM to declare Coupon Rate for the period from March 23, 2025 to September 22, 2025.

newsList.News_Title: MPETROLEUM: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
newsList.News_Text: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on February 25, 2025 at 6:00 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the Second Quarter (Q2) period ended December 31, 2024.

newsList.News_Title: CBLPBOND: Trustee Meeting to declare Coupon Rate
newsList.News_Text: City Bank PLC. has informed that a meeting of the Trustee of City Bank Perpetual Bond will be held on February 20, 2025 at 3:00 PM to declare Coupon Rate applicable for the period from March 01, 2025 to August 31, 2025.

newsList.News_Title: UTTARABANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
newsList.News_Text: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on July 11, 2024 at 3:00 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the Second Quarter (Q2) period ended June 30, 2024.

Trading of the shares of the company will be allowed only in the Spot Market and Block transaction will also be settled as per spot settlement cycle with cum benefit from 07.07.2024 to 08.07.2024 and trading of the shares will remain suspended on record date i.e., 09.07.2024 for Interim Dividend Declaration.
Trading of the shares of the company will resume on 07.07.2024.
Trading of APSCL Non-Convertible and Fully Redeemable Coupon Bearing Bond will resume on 07.07.2024.
